headline: Congress goes dark for the long weekend with both chambers in pro forma limbo as lawmakers prepare for Tuesday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Friday, September 4, meeting for just 34 seconds before adjourning until Tuesday. No legislative business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Friday, September 4, introducing 6 new bills and 2 resolutions before adjourning after just two minutes. No votes or quorum calls took place.
